dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - June 23, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Astros Stun Blue Jays in Toronto, Mariners Edge Pirates**

The Houston Astros pulled off a thrilling 9-7 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Joey Loperfido's four-RBI performance leading the charge. The standout slugger crushed a home run and singled twice, while Yordan Alvarez and Isaac Paredes also contributed to the Astros' offense. Peter Lambert pitched 4.2 innings, striking out six and allowing two earned runs.

In another notable contest, the Seattle Mariners edged the Pittsburgh Pirates 3-2, thanks in part to Cole Young's go-ahead home run in the fifth inning. George Kirby pitched six strong innings, fanning five and yielding one earned run.
